headword: {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}
reading: ふりこみてすうりょう

definitions.explanation: The fee charged by a bank or financial institution for processing a money transfer. A common everyday banking term in Japan, where bank transfers are a standard payment method.

examples.japanese: {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかる。
{振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}は{無料|むりょう}ですか。
ネットバンキングを{使|つか}えば{振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}が{安|やす}くなることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: If you use online banking, the transfer fee is often cheaper.

notes:
Compound of {振込|ふりこみ} (bank transfer) and {手数料|てすうりょう} (handling fee). In Japan, bank transfers ({振込|ふりこみ}) are one of the most common payment methods for rent, utilities, and business transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかる: a transfer fee is charged
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}が{無料|むりょう}: the transfer fee is free
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}を{負担|ふたん}する: to bear the transfer fee
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}{込|こ}み: transfer fee included

USAGE:
Transfer fees vary depending on the bank, whether the transfer is within the same bank or to a different bank, and whether it is done at an ATM, at a counter, or online. Many Japanese banks offer lower {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう} for online transactions.
